Friendzy / 100 Truth or Dare questions

100 Truth or Dare questions

Truth or Dare is the classic for a reason. Here are 50 truths and 50 dares that are funny and harmless, so they work for sleepovers, family nights and parties with mixed ages.

How to play

  1. Take turns: each player picks Truth or Dare.
  2. Truth: answer the question honestly.
  3. Dare: do the challenge (or take the group's agreed penalty).
  4. Pass to the next player.

50 truths

  1. What's the most embarrassing thing you've ever done in public?
  2. Have you ever laughed so hard you cried at an inappropriate moment?
  3. Have you ever waved back at someone who wasn't waving at you?
  4. What's something you did as a kid that you'd never admit to now?
  5. What's an opinion you'd never say out loud normally?
  6. What's your real opinion on social media?
  7. Who's the most dramatic person you know outside this room?
  8. Have you ever had a dream about someone in this room?
  9. If you had unlimited money, what's the weirdest thing you'd buy?
  10. What's a dream you've given up on that you still think about?
  11. What's something you've always wanted to say to someone but never could?
  12. What's the hardest thing you've ever had to forgive?
  13. What's the most likes you've ever gotten on a post and what was it?
  14. What's the most dramatic thing you've seen play out on social media?
  15. What's something your parents did that you swore you'd never do?
  16. What's the most unfair thing a sibling ever got away with?
  17. What's the weirdest thing you've ever eaten out of curiosity?
  18. What's the worst meal you've ever cooked and served to someone?
  19. Have you ever rehearsed a conversation in your head that never happened?
  20. What's the most ridiculous thing you've bought because of an influencer?
  21. What's the longest you've ever slept in?
  22. What's the longest text you've written and then completely deleted?
  23. What's a food combination you eat that everyone else thinks is disgusting?
  24. What's something you've convinced yourself is healthy that definitely isn't?
  25. Have you ever pretended to be asleep to avoid a conversation?
  26. Have you ever been rude to someone who was just being nice?
  27. Have you ever purposely lost to make someone else feel good?
  28. What's the most awkward moment you've had in an elevator?
  29. Have you ever not returned a call because it felt too awkward to call back late?
  30. Have you ever been caught faking enthusiasm about a gift?
  31. Have you ever been too proud to ask for directions and got hopelessly lost?
  32. What's the worst advice you've confidently given?
  33. Have you ever purposely started a rumour about yourself?
  34. What's the most embarrassing thing that's ever happened during an important call?
  35. What's something you genuinely cannot do that most people find easy?
  36. What's a weird thing you find oddly satisfying?
  37. What's the most elaborate lie you've ever constructed?
  38. What's the worst lie a dentist or doctor has caught you in?
  39. Have you ever bought something just because it was on sale even though you didn't need it?
  40. Have you ever made a decision you immediately knew was the wrong one but stuck with it anyway?
  41. What's something you used to be embarrassingly bad at and are now still pretty bad at?
  42. What's the worst thing you've ever done to get out of exercise?
  43. What's a compliment you've given that was actually a dig?
  44. Have you ever believed something completely false for an embarrassingly long time?
  45. Have you ever judged someone's music taste and then later secretly loved it?
  46. Have you ever been caught doing something embarrassing and had to pretend it didn't happen?
  47. Have you ever completely forgotten someone's name and had to wing it?
  48. What is a compliment you got that secretly annoyed you?
  49. What is the most embarrassing song you know all the words to?
  50. Have you ever made a bet and then quietly changed the rules when you were losing?

50 dares

  1. Do 10 push-ups right now.
  2. Run on the spot as fast as you can for 20 seconds.
  3. Do your best impression of someone in this room.
  4. Describe someone in the room without saying their name. Others guess.
  5. Show the group your most recent photo taken.
  6. Describe the taste of your favourite snack like a fancy food critic.
  7. Shout 'I LOVE CHEESE' three times like you're on a mountaintop.
  8. Draw a portrait of someone in this room in under 1 minute.
  9. Act like you're receiving the greatest award of your life.
  10. Give the person on your right a genuine compliment they've never heard before.
  11. Tell everyone in the room what their superhero power would be.
  12. Invent a new dance move and teach it to the group.
  13. Say your middle name as dramatically as possible 10 times in a row.
  14. Pretend your chair is a horse and ride it across the room.
  15. Freestyle rap about everyone in the room for 30 seconds.
  16. Bark like a dog every time someone uses the word 'I' for the next 5 minutes.
  17. Let the group ask your phone's assistant something you have to answer honestly.
  18. Do the most dramatic sneeze you are physically capable of.
  19. Pretend to be conducting an orchestra for 30 seconds.
  20. Act out a complete scene from a soap opera with whoever sits next to you.
  21. Do your absolute best moonwalk.
  22. Pretend to be a magician and perform your best trick.
  23. End every single sentence with 'no cap' for the next 3 minutes.
  24. Do a dramatic re-enactment of getting out of bed this morning.
  25. Describe each person in this room using only emojis.
  26. Pretend you're a robot who just learned to feel emotions. 30 seconds.
  27. Greet the next person who speaks as if you haven't seen them in 30 years.
  28. Do your best impression of a robot trying to open a jar.
  29. Make eye contact with someone and describe the weather in the most dramatic way possible.
  30. Speak only in questions for the next 2 minutes.
  31. Act as if you have just received the most unexpected news of your life.
  32. Do your best impression of a very old car trying to start.
  33. Do your best impression of a very serious scientist explaining something silly.
  34. Do your best mime of opening a very large and heavy door.
  35. Mime being a windscreen wiper for 20 seconds.
  36. Do your best impression of a very dramatic hairdresser.
  37. Act like you are a spy trying to blend in and failing immediately.
  38. Do your best impression of a person explaining WiFi to someone from the 1800s.
  39. Act like you are narrating your own documentary as you walk across the room.
  40. Act as if you are trying to sell sand to someone in a desert.
  41. Act as if you are a contestant on a quiz show who knows the answer but cannot hear the question.
  42. Do your best impression of someone who has just read a spoiler for their favourite show.
  43. Do your best impression of someone at the gym who has no idea what they're doing but is very confident.
  44. Do your best impression of someone who has just been told their table isn't ready yet and it's been an hour.
  45. Mime discovering that your shoes are on the wrong feet in the middle of a formal occasion.
  46. Do your best impression of a very confused person trying to follow GPS instructions into a lake.
  47. Do your best impression of a person trying to split a restaurant bill with six people and one calculator.
  48. Act as if you are a very cheerful postman delivering the world's heaviest parcel up five flights of stairs.
  49. Mime a very important business negotiation that is entirely about biscuits.
  50. Mime being the last person at a party who has refused to acknowledge it is over.
